mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(c.id) AS contentId, c.title AS title, c.description AS description, c.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name) FROM content_tags ct JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id WHERE ct.content_id = c.id) AS tagNames, c.embedding_source_hash AS currentSourceHash, c.type AS type, YEAR(c.release_date) AS releaseYear, c.origin_country AS originCountry, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.person_name ORDER BY p.display_order) FROM content_people p WHERE p.content_id = c.id AND p.role_type = 'DIRECTOR') AS directors, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.person_name ORDER BY a.display_order) FROM (SELECT p.person_name, p.display_order FROM content_people p WHERE p.content_id = c.id AND p.role_type = 'ACTOR' ORDER BY p.display_order LIMIT 5) a) AS actors, cs.sport_type AS sportType, cs.league AS league, cs.season AS season, cs.home_team AS homeTeam, cs.away_team AS awayTeam, cs.venue AS venue FROM contents c LEFT JOIN content_sports cs ON cs.content_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE contents SET embedding_source_hash = #{hash} WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId})
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(id) FROM contents WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND embedding_source_hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update:
UPDATE contents SET embedding_source_hash = NULL WHERE id IN
UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId})
